name: neo
description: Puddle Island: a home-made learning game for little kids

paragraphs: A home-made iPad learning game in the spirit of JumpStart and Neopets: playful learning, a familiar pet, and an island to explore. Current age bands run from lap play through early school (ages 6–8); the long-term plan grows through elementary school, roughly grade 5 / age eleven. Every picture and sound is generated in code: no sprites, no audio files.
Play it: (every push to main redeploys via GitHub Actions)
Roadmap · Design and architecture · Games · Ideas · Couch play guide · Verification log · Contributor guidance · Development workflow review
features: 87 small games in eleven themed lands on one island map, each with spoken instructions, gentle hints, adaptive levels and one sticker per round.
A pet she hatches and names, a sticker book, and the pet's treehouse, where things she made hang on the wall and a discovery journal fills up.
The Windy Picnic, a short story that connects three activities.
Couch play for two grown-ups with controllers or a keyboard on a computer: trips, face-offs and challenge courses, with its own save.
A grown-up zone behind a press-and-hold gear (or Esc in a game), and offline play once installed.
